round: first native stage: eight PAM codes on one output channel, DC only, TT 27C

authorisation.granted_scope: implementation, SSH transfer, read-only model and environment checks, native preflight, eight DC measurements and a safe push, as one continuous in-scope action
authorisation.counts_rule: every spectre process counts, including preflight, DUT, help, syntax probes, failures, crashes, aborts and launches whose result was never retrieved; REQUESTED occupies the budget before the process starts and recovery never refunds it; parsing a file or a static check costs nothing
authorisation.independent_of: the old 36-launch PREP draft, the DATA-7B 59/56 account and every future transient budget; no borrowing in either direction
never_authorised_by_this_round: VM power, snapshot or network configuration change

criteria_source.drift_rule: the snapshot below is compared with the live frozen contract on every run, so a criterion cannot change between the preparation round and the measurement round without a named refusal

matrix.order_rule: the two end codes run and pass first; the six middle codes follow. An end code passing is never a reason to skip a middle code
matrix.rows_formula: 8 codes x 19 clamp points, debug and preflight rows excluded
matrix.sign_convention: Ip_branch (clamp_node data_out) iprobe, so I_sink = Ip_branch with no negation and no abs(); a negative reading is diagnosed, never flipped

passing_ceiling.syntax_claim_rule: native netlist syntax is only ever confirmed for the derived DC decks that actually ran, never extrapolated to the whole hierarchy or to transient

refusals: launch without the authorisation marker set, before any file is written
launch when the persisted account shows no budget left
a deck that differs from the frozen delivered bytes in anything but the recorded derived-copy rule
an extraction with a non-finite value, a missing clamp point, a duplicate point, a missing 1.20 V point, a missing unit on the sweep axis or a deck/output identity mismatch
a judgement that normalises a whole-ladder shortfall into a pass
a result row copied from the nominal ladder instead of the native output
